assets.caption: The scene is a surreal and vibrant cylindrical tunnel, rendered in a highly stylized, almost fantastical manner, exuding an energetic and whimsical tone. The long, straight tunnel is the interior of a washing machine drum, viewed from within, with its axis extending to a bright warm-golden vanishing point. The walls are a deep glossy metallic magenta and violet, streaked with long white-pink specular reflections that run lengthwise along the tunnel. Regular rows of dark, capsule-shaped perforation slots are arranged around the circumference of the tunnel walls, positioned between the ring bands. Approximately ten evenly spaced, identical, circular, polished reflective yellow-gold ring bands, each flat with a double lip, divide the tunnel into equal bays, diminishing in size uniformly towards the distant vanishing point. Within each bay, just above the river, a small copper-gold half-dome fitting is mounted on each side wall. The entire floor of the tunnel is filled wall-to-wall by a broad, thick, glossy electric-cyan river, interwoven with hot-pink swirling bands, which meanders in smooth S-bends towards the vanishing point, reflecting white-blue light and displaying numerous star-shaped glints. Both sides of the river are lined with banks of soft white foam, interspersed with transparent iridescent soap bubbles. The 360 scene is faultless.
